title: Shymora Cooper
description: Opposed Gov Youngkin’s model policies on transgender students that prohibited boys in girls’ locker rooms and bathrooms.
body:
# Nicole Richardson

# Board Member

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/cooper-profile.png)

- **[Claimed](https://web.archive.org/web/20240912183616/https:/www.cvilletomorrow.org/qa-with-the-4-candidates-seeking-the-4-seats-on-the-charlottesville-city-school-board/)** “equity and anti-bias education are crucial components.”
- **[Opposed](https://web.archive.org/web/20240912183616/https:/www.cvilletomorrow.org/qa-with-the-4-candidates-seeking-the-4-seats-on-the-charlottesville-city-school-board/)** Gov Youngkin’s model policies on transgender students that prohibited boys in girls’ locker rooms and bathrooms.
- Said she is the mother of a **[transgender child](https://web.archive.org/web/20240912183616/https:/www.cvilletomorrow.org/qa-with-the-4-candidates-seeking-the-4-seats-on-the-charlottesville-city-school-board/)**.
